official_sources.label: Study in Korea — 2027 GKS-U Application Guidelines
Study in Korea — 2026 GKS-G Application Guidelines

documents.label: Application Form
documents.notes: Embassy Track: complete in Study in Korea for the first round; successful first-round applicants print and sign the form for NIIED's second round. University Track follows the university's own first-round method.

documents.label: Personal Statement
documents.notes: May be written in English or Korean. Embassy Track applicants complete it in the online system for the first round.

documents.label: Study Plan
documents.notes: May be written in English or Korean. Keep the intended field/department consistent with the rest of the application.

documents.label: Recommendation Letter
documents.notes: One letter is required. Embassy Track uploads a scanned copy for the first round; successful first-round applicants submit the original letter for NIIED's second round.

documents.label: Consent to Collect and Use Personal Information
Proof of citizenship and family relationship
documents.notes: Embassy Track uploads a scanned copy for the first round. Successful first-round applicants submit the required authenticated original/certified document for NIIED's second round.

documents.label: High school graduation / expected graduation certificate
documents.notes: Expected graduates must satisfy the 2027 guideline's graduation deadline and later provide the final document when required.

documents.label: Associate-degree graduation / expected graduation certificate
documents.condition: Required if the applicant is applying on the basis of an associate-degree program.

documents.label: Associate-degree academic transcript
documents.condition: Required if applicable to the applicant's academic pathway.

documents.label: Overseas Korean / adoptee / Korean-citizenship-renunciation / Korean War veteran-descendant proof
documents.condition: Required only for applicants claiming the relevant status.

documents.label: TOPIK / English proficiency score report
documents.notes: Submit if necessary. University/department-specific language rules may be stricter and belong in Requirement Checker.

documents.label: Awards / activity / achievement certificates
documents.notes: Up to five documents from high school onward.

documents.label: Passport copy
documents.notes: Submit if necessary, especially when other citizenship evidence does not clearly show citizenship information.

documents.label: Apostille / consular confirmation / certified translation
documents.condition: Embassy Track first round uses scanned copies; authentication generally becomes relevant for required certificates submitted after passing Round 1. Country-specific embassy instructions can add local steps.
documents.notes: Use the Apostille Guide for the stage distinction and country-specific cautions.

documents.label: Letter of Invitation
documents.condition: Research program applicants where required by the research-program university.

documents.label: Korean Language Program Exemption Application
documents.condition: Only for applicants who qualify under the 2026 guideline.

documents.label: Consent to Collect and Use Personal Information
Bachelor's / previous degree graduation certificate
documents.notes: Expected graduates must later provide the final official degree certificate by the deadline in the guideline.

documents.label: Proof of citizenship / family relationship
documents.notes: Exact accepted document types and authentication depend on the first-round institution/country.

documents.label: TOPIK / English proficiency score
documents.condition: Required only where the selected university/program or GKS specialization explicitly requires it.

documents.label: Apostille / consular confirmation / certified translation
documents.condition: Depends on document type, issuing country, language, and first-round institution.
documents.notes: Country/embassy instructions can be stricter or operationally different.
